title: Rest with Guanyin
line: For comfort: the one who hears the cries of the world.
intro: Guanyin, the bodhisattva of compassion in Chinese Buddhism (Kannon in Japan, Avalokiteshvara in India and Tibet), is said to hear every cry of suffering. This practice brings her your own, and asks her mercy for others too.
offering: Water, a flower, or a quiet word for someone who is suffering.

steps.title: Arrive
steps.text: Breathe slowly. Let the out-breath be longer.

steps.title: Light a lamp
steps.text: For yourself, and for anyone who is hurting tonight.

steps.title: Her name
steps.text: Repeat her name softly, as a child calls for its mother.

steps.title: Be heard
steps.prompt: What I would like to be heard, tonight.

steps.title: Close
steps.text: Close with the six syllables of compassion.

after: You have been heard. Be gentle with yourself for the rest of the day.
